explication: StreamingSVD turns input images into long, temporally consistent videos through autoregressive image-to-video generation, followed by video enhancement (including optional randomized blending) and frame interpolation. The inference entry point prepares the input and components; the StreamingSVD trainer owns generation, while enhancement and interpolation are distinct downstream capabilities. The graph also shows the model-loading and diffusion-model layers. Some implementation excerpts are partial, so uncertain runtime links are marked dashed with no evidence path.
